title: Fashion Room Service
includes: The Montreal Fashion Society Gift Bag
Presented pieces are not included (Clothes, accessories, shoes, etc.)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Discover Montreal’s fashion designers & brands as you shop original pieces based on your personal style in the comfort of your room and learn about the local fashion scene. This 2 hours experience is perfect to complete your shopping in Montreal or to maximize your time by having authentic local wearable art in line with your style and objectives in the form of a mini pop up shop in your room. Prior to your tour, you'll receive a short questionnaire that your style coach will use to help customize your fashion room service. On the menu, a personalized selection of stylish pieces carefully crafted by local Montreal designers and brands, original vintage finds and other items you might like. Think of this experience as a fashion room service accompanied with a side of storytelling, an ounce of cultural quirkiness served with a rich plate of Montreal Style DNA, tips and tricks for shopping and styling your wardrobe like a pro along with some fashion anecdotes and a gift bag to take home.
